from pydantic import BaseModel, Field

class CompanyReport(BaseModel):
    """Captures the profit information for one company from its financial report."""
    company_name: str | None = Field(description="The name of the company")
    stock_code: str | None = Field(description="The stock market code of the company")
    period: str | None = Field(description="The reporting period, e.g. '2024 Q1'")
    total_profit_amount: float | None = Field(description="The total profit value in the base currency unit")
    quote: str | None = Field(description="A short excerpt from the document containing the profit figure")

class Parse(BaseModel):
    company_reports: list[CompanyReport]
